visual.general_description: Four-part brain MRI composite: one axial, four coronal, one larger axial and four sagittal slices.
visual.detailed_description: Composite of four image groups on a dark background, photographed or copied from film rather than clean exports. Top left: one axial brain slice with the edge of a neighbouring slice cut off at the top; ventricles and sulci look dark against gray brain, with a darker irregular region in the posterior-lateral part of the image-left hemisphere, a vertical scale ruler at the right edge and small printed window text at the bottom right. Top right: a two-by-two grid of four coronal slices, cerebrospinal fluid spaces bright, with a scale ruler on the right side of each tile and small printed text along the bottom. Bottom left: a larger axial slice with bright cerebrospinal fluid spaces and dark deep gray structures; black rectangular blocks cover the top edge and the right edge where text would be, with a few characters left visible at the right edge. Bottom right: a two-by-two grid of four sagittal slices with bright fluid spaces, scale rulers on the right of each tile and small printed text at the bottom. No panel letters, arrows or left/right orientation markers are legible.

visual.general_description: Single axial brain MRI image with scanner overlay text.
visual.detailed_description: One axial brain image that looks photographed from a screen or film, with dark background and scanner-style overlay text. The top left carries a few lines of acquisition text (scanner and sequence descriptors); the top right carries a block of text with a hospital line, an accession line, a name line, an age and sex line that also carries an ID number, a date and a time; the bottom edge repeats scanner and hospital lines, partly overlapping the brain. Letters printed vertically at the left edge and a scale ruler at the right edge are visible. Brain: gray parenchyma with dark enlarged lateral ventricles and widened sulci; a bright patch of increased signal near the image-left lateral ventricle and bright periventricular areas posteriorly, and a dark, irregular, cystic-looking region at the posterior-lateral image-left hemisphere. No arrows or panel labels.

visual.general_description: Three axial post-operative CT brain slices.
visual.detailed_description: Three axial non-contrast-appearing CT brain slices side by side on a black background, each showing a bright skull ring with small dark air pockets at the front. The second and third slices have a small red letter A centered above the head; the first has none. In all three, the ventricles and sulci are dark gray against gray brain, and a darker low-density area lies in the image-left hemisphere lateral to the deep gray nuclei; it is similar in the three slices. No arrow, circle, outline or colored overlay marks the lesion; no left/right labels or text values are visible.
